meta.title: useMemo — why inline objects in deps defeat memoization

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: ObjectDepDemo shows the most common useMemo trap: passing an inline object as a dep. The object is a new reference every render, so the memo never caches — it's equivalent to no memo at all.

annotations.label: Inline object dep = no cache
annotations.detail: { items, multiplier } is constructed fresh each render. React sees a new object reference every time, so the "did deps change?" check is always true. Remove the object wrapper and depend on the primitives directly.
